data.body: Leaf c61a-9f8f-8ef9-4601: signed plan-review PASS, claimed by joeoakhart@navapbc.com. Entered held-out TDD on strong/coordinator tier. Test contract card: authoritative contract = ticket AC + docs/exit-codes.md unknown-command convention; precondition = both tokens currently route as live commands; production path = real `python -m rebar.cli` subprocess plus shipped help/package/docs; tier = CLI contract/E2E because dispatch, streams, exit code, help, and packaging must agree; postcondition = each token exits 1 with exact unknown-subcommand diagnostic, neither is advertised, and active shipped surfaces contain zero retired tokens; CI gate = make test. Surface parity: CLI in scope; MCP/API out (no corresponding tools); library facade out (no public command facade); automated callers in scope via full src/rebar string oracle; dual-direction out (command retirement has no mirror operation). Contention exempt: deletion rides no new composed/check-then-act store seam.
